news.title: Nani's The Paradise Crosses Rs 165 Crore Globally After Resilient Monday
news.summary: Nani starrer The Paradise has successfully crossed the Rs 155 crore mark worldwide following its opening weekend. Despite a mixed reception, the Srikanth Odela directorial added nearly Rs 10 crore on its first Monday to push global collections to approximately Rs 165 crore. The film now faces a critical weekday test to see how well its momentum holds over the coming days.

news.title: Prabhas Lineup Sparks Debate Over Fauzi and Spirit Release Order
news.summary: Prabhas fans are actively discussing whether his upcoming film Spirit will hit screens ahead of Fauzi. While Fauzi was initially slated for a December 2026 release, makers stepped back from the date to focus thoroughly on post-production without compromising quality. Meanwhile, Sandeep Vanga's directorial Spirit remains on track for its scheduled March 2027 arrival.

news.title: Sumanth Prabhas Starrer Romanchakam Gears Up For Netflix Premiere
news.summary: The youthful romantic comedy Romanchakam is heading to Netflix on October 1, 2026, following its theatrical release earlier in September. Starring Sumanth Prabhas and Ananthika Sanilkumar, the film will stream in multiple languages including Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, and Hindi. Backed by solid digital deals, the low-budget venture successfully yielded profits for its makers after completing its theatrical run.

news.title: The Paradise Maintains Solid Footfalls Across Regions On Working Day
news.summary: Nani and Srikanth Odela's mass action entertainer continues to pull audiences to theaters well past its opening weekend. The film registered over 1.13 lakh ticket sales on BookMyShow and District for Monday, showing steady demand. Strong theatrical occupancies across Hyderabad, the Nizam region, and Andhra Pradesh highlighted the project's lasting pull on working days.

news.title: Meenakshi Chaudhary Eyed for Nani and Sujeeth's Bloody Romeo
news.summary: Actor Nani is taking a brief break following his recent release before stepping onto the sets of his next venture, Bloody Romeo, directed by Sujeeth. Industry speculation indicates that Meenakshi Chaudhary is currently being considered for the female lead role in this action drama. While the makers have yet to officially confirm her casting, the project is backed by Niharika Entertainment with music composed by Pravin Lakkaraju.

news.title: Nag Ashwin Prepares for Kalki 2 Production With Prabhas
news.summary: The massive success of the sci-fi mythological epic Kalki 2898 AD has fueled immense anticipation for its upcoming sequel directed by Nag Ashwin. Amid ongoing speculation regarding Dulquer Salmaan potentially reprising his role as Captain in flashback sequences, the director has noted that no new cast additions are planned. Regular filming for the sequel is scheduled to commence in October, with lead stars Prabhas, Amitabh Bachchan, and Kamal Haasan returning.

news.title: Meenakshi Chaudhary in Talks to Star Alongside Nani in Bloody Romeo
news.summary: Natural Star Nani is gearing up for his upcoming stylish action entertainer titled Bloody Romeo, directed by Sujeeth. Meenakshi Chaudhary is reportedly in discussions to play the leading lady, with significant portions of the movie slated for filming in London. The high-budget project also features Malayalam actor Prithviraj Sukumaran in a crucial role and is being planned for a summer release.

news.title: Box Office Update: Nani's The Paradise Crosses Significant Milestone
news.summary: Nani's high-grossing film The Paradise has successfully surpassed the Rs. 155 crore worldwide gross mark despite experiencing a natural weekday dip in ticket sales following a powerful opening weekend. The multilingual drama continues to draw audiences while completing its theatrical run alongside other concurrent box office releases. Fans and trade analysts are closely monitoring its extended box office performance across regions.

news.title: Ram Charan Extends Deep Appreciation to Ganga Hospital Medical Team After Wrist Surgery
news.summary: Global Star Ram Charan has shared his heartfelt thanks with the doctors, nurses, and staff at Ganga Hospital following his successful wrist treatment and the removal of his cast. The actor underwent surgery after sustaining an injury while filming Peddi and is now gearing up for a rigorous phase of physiotherapy. During his visit, he also congratulated the medical institution for earning a prestigious international research award.

news.title: Rajinikanth's Highly Anticipated Action Sequel Jailer 2 Locks Trailer Release Date
news.summary: Superstar Rajinikanth's upcoming action drama Jailer 2 is preparing for a grand promotional blitz ahead of its theatrical debut for the Dussehra festival. The makers have officially locked the theatrical trailer launch for October 5, with a musical album release planned prior. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the star-studded sequel features an ensemble cast and high-profile cameos from across Indian cinema.

news.title: How Working on Sita Ramam Led Rashmika Mandanna to Star in Mysaa
news.summary: Director Rawindra Pulle has revealed that Rashmika Mandanna's involvement in the upcoming period action drama Mysaa began during their time together on Sita Ramam. Impressed by an intense expression of anger in the actor's eyes while directing a sequence, the filmmaker knew he had found his lead protagonist. Rashmika later committed to the Gond tribe-based project, undergoing specialized physical training in Italy and Thailand for demanding action sequences.

news.title: What Lies Ahead for Director Srikanth Odela?
news.summary: Director Srikanth Odela faces an uncertain path following mixed audience reactions to The Paradise, with Nani clarifying that an anticipated collaboration with Chiranjeevi is not happening immediately. Observers are closely watching to see which star will next trust his vision and how he plans to bounce back. The upcoming phase leaves him weighing his writing options and deciding his next major cinematic step.

news.title: Jailer 2 Gears Up for October Release with Trailer on the Horizon
news.summary: The Rajinikanth-starrer Jailer 2 is preparing to hit theaters on October 15 for the Dusshera season under Nelson Dilipkumar's direction. Makers have planned a series of promotional events, including the album launch and an official theatrical trailer release on October 5. The high-profile sequel features a massive ensemble cast alongside several notable guest cameos and music by Anirudh.

news.title: Karthik Subbaraj's Dorothy Struggles at the Box Office Despite Buzz
news.summary: Keerthy Suresh's period drama Dorothy, directed by Karthik Subbaraj, has drawn substantial attention from festival screenings and social media controversies alike. However, this online visibility has not converted into strong ticket sales, netting only Rs. 3.5 crores gross during its opening weekend in Tamil Nadu. The project now looks to see if its upcoming Telugu version can improve its commercial performance.

news.title: Jitin Gulati Opens Up on Working in Prabhas' Fauzi and Akshaye Khanna's Mahakali
news.summary: Actor Jitin Gulati recently shared his filming experiences for upcoming high-profile projects, highlighting the extensive patience required for makeup prep on Mahakali. He praised Akshaye Khanna's incredible intensity and praised Hanu Raghavapudi's ability to maintain emotional depth amidst the massive scale of Prabhas' Fauzi. Furthermore, he described Prabhas as an ultimate collaborative team player who brings joy to the set.

news.title: SS Karthikeya Takes Charge of Global Promotional Campaign for SS Rajamouli and Mahesh Babu's Varanasi
news.summary: Producer SS Karthikeya has revealed that he will shift his complete focus to the highly anticipated Mahesh Babu starrer Varanasi, directed by SS Rajamouli, following the release of Don't Trouble The Trouble. Karthikeya shared that extensive global marketing plans are already in place for an unprecedented promotional scale in Indian cinema, with several exciting ideas currently in development.

news.title: Thaman and Ramajogayya Sastry Share Lighthearted Banter at Aadarsha Kutumbam Song Launch
news.summary: Music composer Thaman and lyricist Ramajogayya Sastry shared a humorous exchange during the launch of the song Narayanamma from the Venkatesh Daggubati starrer Aadarsha Kutumbam. Thaman playfully teased the lyricist over his use of the respectful honorific "garu," generating laughter and highlighting their friendly working rapport.

news.title: Raja Kumari Debuts as Music Director and Contributes Vocals for English-Language Film Impure
news.summary: Renowned musician Raja Kumari is making her debut as a music director alongside Karan Pandav for the English-language film Impure, which features a desi cast and crew. She has also lent her vocals and rap to the Sangeet track OMG, with the film slated for a theatrical release on October 2.

news.title: Megastar Chiranjeevi in Talks for an OTT Celebrity Talk Show
news.summary: Iconic actor Chiranjeevi is reportedly in discussions to anchor a high-profile celebrity talk show for Netflix. While negotiations are progressing, an official announcement regarding the project is expected soon.

news.title: Director Rahul Sankrityan Details the Historical Focus of Ranabaali
news.summary: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna's period action drama Ranabaali centers on the devastating Great Madras Famine rather than a standard freedom struggle narrative. Director Rahul Sankrityan noted that the film honors the millions who suffered during the tragedy through extensive historical research.

news.title: Akhira Nandan Shares a Memorable Moment with Nani Following The Paradise Success
news.summary: As Nani's latest film The Paradise crosses the Rs. 155 crore mark globally in its opening weekend, young actor Akhira Nandan posted a photo with the lead star on social media. Akhira, who portrayed the younger version of Jadal in the movie, expressed gratitude for the opportunity to be part of the project.

news.title: Allu Sirish Clarifies Temple Noise Complaint After Online Backlash
news.summary: Actor Allu Sirish faced criticism online after reporting late-night loudspeaker noise from a Hanuman temple near his Hyderabad residence. He later clarified that his grievance focused strictly on civic responsibility and untimely volume rather than religious devotion.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Smashes Records With Massive Weekend Figures
news.summary: Actor Nani's latest movie, The Paradise, registered a strong opening weekend by crossing Rs. 7.2 crore nett in the Hindi market and achieving a global gross of Rs. 155 crore. The Srikanth Odela directorial also set new benchmarks for the actor in Karnataka and through massive advance ticket bookings.

news.title: The Paradise Crosses $2 Million Milestone in North America
news.summary: Nani's action drama The Paradise has successfully surpassed the $2 million gross mark in North America during its opening weekend. Despite a mixed critical response, the film continues its strong international run alongside impressive worldwide ticket sales.

news.title: Karthi's Sardar 2 Locking Its Digital Premiere On Amazon Prime Video
news.summary: Following its theatrical arrival on September 10, 2026, the Karthi-starrer Sardar 2 is heading to digital streaming on Amazon Prime Video starting October 1, 2026. The action flick features Malavika Mohanan alongside Ashika Ranganath, with SJ Suryah playing the villain and musical scoring by Sam CS.

news.title: Megastar Chiranjeevi Reportedly In Talks With Netflix For A New Podcast Series
news.summary: Iconic actor Chiranjeevi is rumored to collaborate with Netflix for an upcoming multi-episode podcast discussing his extensive cinematic journey and personal experiences. The project, reportedly backed by his daughter Sushmita Konidela, will give fans an intimate look into the veteran star's legendary career.
